description: A small white cubby-style bookshelf with several thin books sits in the back-right corner of the tabletop. The right hand reaches to the cubby, grips a red book and pulls it straight out to place it flat on the table, then pulls out a green book and sets it beside the red one; next it tugs out another darker book and lays it down near the others, while the left hand stays near the front with minimal movement and not touching any object.
